Strategy 2 buys taken only while each stock is in an uptrend (200-day-average rule from nifty50_uptrends_200dma.md). Delivery, same-day sells allowed, FYERS charges only, ₹1,00,000 per trade, all 50 stocks, all timeframes, entries from 1 Jan

  1. Education, not investment advice. Report with charges by type and per-stock tables:

../../../projects/trading-equation-backtests/reports/STRATEGY2_UPTRENDS_REPORT.md. Every trade: reports/strategy2_uptrends/trades_all.csv.

1. The rules

Buy: MACD histogram bigger than the previous candle and Stoch RSI blue crosses above orange with blue below 50 → buy at that candle's close. Sell at the close of the first later candle where blue meets orange. Shares = ₹1,00,000 ÷ price.

Buys allowed only on these dates (the sell follows the normal rule):

  • MAIN: each stock's main uptrend, start to end date. Uses hindsight, because you only know which uptrend was the biggest after it has ended.
  • LIVE: any 200-day-average uptrend, from the day after the 5th close above the average until the day before the 5th close below it. Tradable in real time.

4-hour MAIN in detail: 1,955 buys · 3,00,943 shares · 41.4% winners · 30 of 50 stocks profitable · gross +₹9.02L − FYERS charges ₹5.48L = net +₹3.54L · average move +0.47% vs 0.28% charges · +₹3.0L even without the best 3 trades. By year: 2023 +₹2.14L · 2024 +₹1.19L · 2025 +₹64k · 2026 −₹44k.

3. What it means

  • Restricting buys to uptrends turns 4-hour and daily from losses into profits. Without the filter (strategy2_nifty50_delivery.md) 4-hour buys lost ₹4.06L and daily ₹1.49L.
  • But the MAIN dates use hindsight. Inside the main uptrend even random buys make money (+₹1.56L on 4-hour, +₹4.51L on daily).
    • 4-hour: the strategy beat random buys in 96% of runs, so the entry adds something on top of the uptrend.
    • Daily: it's mostly the uptrend (beats only 69%).
  • The version you could actually trade (LIVE) mostly loses. 4-hour −₹2.67L. Daily +₹49k, about the same as random buys (+₹38k), and it lost ₹2.36L in 2026. Real-time uptrends include false starts and late-trend buys that the hindsight "main uptrend" leaves out.
  • 15-min, 30-min and 1-hour lose either way. The move per trade (−0.08% to +0.11%) is below the 0.12–0.21% charges.

4. Lesson

Strategy 2's 4-hour entry adds real value inside a strong uptrend: it beat random buys in 96% of runs. The problem is knowing you're in one. A plain 200-day average filter isn't enough. Ideas worth testing next on 4-hour LIVE: a stronger trend filter (e.g. 200-day average rising and price within 10% of its 52-week high), or a market filter (only buy when Nifty itself is above its 200-day average), which helped in earlier tests (backtest_results_summary.md).
